properties.notes: Since 2018 Brownfield Land Register, a new permission has been approved: • Planning permission 17/02261/F approved for the demolition of no. 19 Church Road and the erection of 7 new detached dwellings on land to the rear of 17-23 Church Road and 58-60 Massetts Road 2017-12-21. • Planning permission 19/01875/F approved for the subdivision of Plot 2 2019-11-27.. Planning permission 17/02261/F for the demolition of no. 19 Church Road and the erection of 7 new detached dwellings on land to the rear of 17-23 Church Road and 58-60 Massetts Road Horley, with access from Church Road, together with carparking and landscaping. Subsequent planning permission 19/01875/F approved for the subdivision of Plot 2 into a pair of semi-detached 3-bedroom houses.
